name: Leira De Siriuberrisa
source:
One of the princesses of the garden. She is fairly arrogant, learns fast, and is smart. She does not like outdoor movement or activities. She is very self-centered.

[spoiler]She is the former Princess of Dius, a country Irell destroyed. She harbors a hatred of him because of it.[/spoiler]
